title: FMI Weather + Fingrid Wind/Solar Nowcast Input

fingridApiKey.title: Fingrid API key
fingridApiKey.description: Your free key from data.fingrid.fi (developer portal > Open Data starter). Sent only in the x-api-key HTTP header; never logged or stored in output. Optional if mode is 'station_weather'.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Joined FMI Weather + Fingrid Wind/Solar/Consumption Nowcast Feed
FMI Hub Weather Forecast Only (no Fingrid key needed)
mode.description: Select 'joined_nowcast' to join FMI weather with Fingrid wind/solar/consumption forecasts and actuals, or 'station_weather' for FMI hub forecasts only.

places.title: Finnish energy & weather hubs
places.description: FMI forecast locations representing Finnish wind, solar, and demand hubs.

hoursBack.title: Hours back
hoursBack.description: Hours of recent window to include for actual vs forecast wind comparison and ramp calculation.

topN.title: EV smart-charging recommended hours (top N)
topN.description: Number of lowest-residual-load hours to flag with isEvChargeRecommended=true.

includeStationBreakdown.title: Include per-hub station breakdown
includeStationBreakdown.description: Attach per-hub FMI weather values (Oulu, Vaasa, Pori, Helsinki, Lappeenranta) inside each hourly record.
